requirements.label: Qualifications for entry to the one-year top-up
requirements.details: Applicants normally present a DipHE or a relevant Level 5 qualification. Accepted Level 5 qualifications include a foundation degree, HND, award, certificate, diploma or NVQ. International alternatives include an advanced or higher diploma or an associate degree. Two completed years of a relevant BA (Hons) at a recognised institution are another route.

requirements.label: How previous study is assessed
requirements.details: Admissions assesses each top-up application individually, taking account of the qualification system in the applicant’s country and the match between previously studied modules and the degree.

requirements.details: IELTS requires 6.0 overall and at least 5.5 in every component.

source.title: Aberystwyth University · Undergraduate English Requirements

requirements.label: TOEFL iBT taken at a test centre
requirements.details: The older scale requires 88 overall with reading 18, listening 17, speaking 20 and writing 17. The newer scale requires 4.0 overall and at least 4.0 per component. The table labels tests before 20 January 2026 and after 21 January 2026. Confirm the applicable scale for a test on a boundary date.

source.title: Aberystwyth University · Undergraduate English Requirements

requirements.label: Trinity ISE
requirements.details: A Trinity ISE score of 90 overall is required, including at least 80 in each skill.

source.title: Aberystwyth University · Undergraduate English Requirements

requirements.label: Oxford ELLT
requirements.details: The Digital and Global versions require 6 overall and at least 5 in every component.

source.title: Aberystwyth University · Undergraduate English Requirements

requirements.label: Aberystwyth International English Centre
requirements.details: A pre-sessional course report requires a pass at 50% overall, with at least 40% per component. The International Foundation Certificate alternative requires an overall pass, 50–59% in English and at least 50% in each module.

source.title: Aberystwyth University · Undergraduate English Requirements

requirements.label: Cambridge B2 English tests
requirements.details: B2 First requires B. B2 Business Vantage requires C. For either qualification the minimum component score is 162.

source.title: Aberystwyth University · Undergraduate English Requirements

requirements.label: Cambridge advanced English tests
requirements.details: C1 Advanced, C2 Proficiency and C1 Business Higher each require grade C with at least 162 per component.

source.title: Aberystwyth University · Undergraduate English Requirements

requirements.label: Pearson PTE Academic
requirements.details: PTE Academic requires 59 overall and at least 59 in every component.

source.title: Aberystwyth University · Undergraduate English Requirements

requirements.label: School qualifications for English-language evidence
requirements.details: The table accepts IGCSE C/4, grade E in UK AS-level English Language, grade C or higher in Cambridge O Level, or C/4 in UK GCSE or O-level English Language.

requirements.label: US-curriculum AP evidence for English
requirements.details: In its alternative English qualifications for non-EEA applicants, the university lists a US-curriculum AP score of at least 3. Supply evidence of the qualification. The table does not name an AP subject for this use.
